title: GuaranteeCertificate
description: DRAFT 2026-05-30. The per-node guarantee fold's output: what can honestly be claimed about a result, the tier it actually earned, any per-result demotion, and recorded absences. Pinned to the node by CID. Pfa is distributional and NOT provable in any proof assistant; the bounded tier is where the real detection guarantee lives. See ../design/self_validation_architecture.md §4.

subject_cid.description: CID of the node this certificate certifies (one hash, three roles).

tier.description: The tier the result ACTUALLY earned, computed (not asserted) from what held on its inputs. Ordered strongest-to-weakest; 'absent' = the guarantee joint was not present.

machine_checked.description: Deterministic skeleton only (round-off bound / algebraic identity / threshold monotonicity) — NOT the Pfa claim. Polyglot joint (Coq+Flocq+Gappa or F*→C), off the executable path.

bounded.description: Where the real detection guarantee lives — a PAIR: an analytic conditional bound + a distribution-free empirical bound.

analytic.description: Closed-form CFAR/Neyman-Pearson Pfa, CONDITIONAL on the noise model holding.

examples: homogeneous reference window; white Gaussian noise

empirical.description: Distribution-free, finite-sample, exchangeability-only (conformal). Survives when the noise model does not.

calibration_corpus_cid.description: CID of the calibration data — makes the guarantee reproducible/auditable.

well_formed.description: The floor every result earns: SHACL + metamorphic property tests + contracts.

demotion.description: Per-result honesty: a runtime monitor found the method's preconditions did NOT hold on this input, so the tier was demoted. Recorded in provenance.

absence.description: Joints not present for this node — recorded, never silently 'fine'. An absent joint pushes its concern to None in the carrier.
